requirement_text.GH#2682: Exam content snapshot at session start; scoring reads only the snapshot (PR a).

task.description: ELIXIR-DEV: implement PR a of the REQ-511 design only (no tests, no commit, no push).

result.summary: PR a implemented. MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors: 'Generated letflow app' (exit 0, full --force recompile of 461 files also clean); mix format --check-formatted: exit 0; mix letflow.check_boundaries: 'OK -- 1640 edges checked, 0 violations'. Tests NOT run (not permitted). pack.json regenerated with generate_pack.exs (session gains exam_snapshot json, queried false, required false). Pure Snapshot smoke run via mix run --no-start (build, jsonb-style round trip, digest, tamper, all grading reasons, number table) behaved as designed.
deviations: D-1 build_from_resolved/4: 4th argument is a map %{origin: :start, exam_id, taken_at} instead of the bare origin (exam_id and taken_at are not derivable from the other arguments).

D-2 LIKERT KEY RULE: design 7.2/T-17 literally says every non-shorttext question needs a correct option; Scoring and the old build_question_row treat likert as having NO correct option. Implemented: single, multiple, truefalse need a correct option; likert needs a complete non-empty likert_options map (weight parsable, polarity positive|negative); shorttext needs neither. Flagged for REVIEWER/CDV: the literal reading would fail every likert exam at start.
D-3 Response.service_unavailable/2 already existed; nothing added to api/response.ex.

D-4 Release wrapper reaches the exam code through Letflow.Modules.Catalog.fetch("exam") plus two new delegates Exam.snapshot_rollout/1 and Exam.snapshot_verify/0, because check_boundaries rule 5 forbids lib/letflow/release/** referencing lib/letflow/modules/exam/** directly (the design's file layout violated the boundary rule). verify/0 logic lives in Rollout.verify/0.

D-5 Rollout actor is the all-zero system uuid (RecordDeadlineSweep precedent) because repository_artifacts.created_by and activation activator_user_id are NOT NULL; Stamp's nil actor is not possible here (OQ-2).

D-6 Detail strings: submit/autosave/state/report_event grading errors use 'exam grading failed; the session was not scored'; start uses 'exam content is invalid; the session was not started'; every snapshot_error is 503 'exam service is being upgraded; retry shortly'. Design only fixed submit/start/503/certificate.
D-7 gate_blocked_total in Stamp counts only :snapshot_not_complete in PR a (prerequisite status is PR b); prerequisites_missing not added.
D-8 Rollout conflict_total counts both :conflict and :managed_cannot_upgrade tenants.

test/letflow/modules/exam/session_test.exs, exam_sessions_test.exs, anti_cheat_test.exs, certificate_test.exs (sessions now require the field + restriction row; live-edit expectations flip)
